items.article: It’s the toppings that make it really special. Here are five versions, from a Toyko classic to a new Cardiff cult hit You need five things: broth, flavour-giving tare, noodles, fat and toppings. And it’s the toppings that make it really special. Here are five versions, from a Toyko classic to a new Cardiff cult hit Watch our guide to the UK’s best ramen renegades in Feed with Jimi Famurewa A t its simplest, ramen is the balance of five elements: broth, tare (secret seasoning sauce), noodles, fat and toppings. If you understand that, this seemingly cryptic and complex corner of Japanese food culture opens right up. The first four take time, but if you pick up a shop-bought stock and some decent noodles, I won’t tell anyone. But the toppings are where the real payoff is: the fastest way to turn a midweek nothing into something worth showing off. A universal note Spring onions should be used to top every bowl (finely diced white onion will work as a backup). Noodle portions are 130g unless stated otherwise, and any specialist items should be available online or at your local Asian supermarket. items.article: Gary Sutton's scheduled execution has been paused after Tennessee Governor Bill Lee halted remaining 2026 executions following Christa Pike's failed lethal injection. Gary Wayne Sutton, a Tennessee death row inmate, has had his execution paused after Governor Bill Lee suspended all remaining executions in the state for 2026 following the failed execution of Christa Pike . Sutton was convicted of the 1992 killings of siblings Tommy Griffin and Connie Branam and has spent three decades on death row. Sutton was scheduled to receive a lethal injection on December 3, but Lee’s order to suspend executions for the rest of the year means the sentence will not be carried out as planned. Sutton, 61, was convicted in 1992 alongside his uncle, James Dellinger, for the murders of Tommy Griffin and Griffin’s sister, Connie Branam. The pair were sentenced to life in prison, and later received death sentences for Griffin’s murder. Dellinger died in prison in 2023 aged 71. Griffin, 24, was found shot in the back of the head near the Little River on February 24, 1992. Branam, 34, was discovered five days later inside her burned vehicle. At the time, Griffin’s family reported an ongoing feud between their family and Sutton’s before the killings.

Alevi described a harrowing scene aboard the flight, with people “screaming, running, panicking, blood.” “At the start, I thought it was a plane malfunction, but then I started hearing screaming about the stabbings,” he said. “We didn’t know what was going to happen,” he said, adding that the possibility of death “was definitely an option.”

items.key: ai:at 71, i'm finally ready to tell the truth about what happened to me at a college frat house
items.text: At 71, I’m Finally Ready To Tell The Truth About What Happened To Me At A College Frat House
items.article: “I swallowed the pain I experienced, and it remained undigested for years, playing havoc with my psyche and my body.” A young woman has filed a civil suit against Cornell University and seven fraternity members she alleges were involved in an incident in which she says she was given drugs and sexually assaulted for seven hours at their college frat house. The suit has brought widespread attention to the alleged assault, which she first reported in October of 2024. The woman, identified as Jane Doe, went on to drop out of Cornell University. Meanwhile, only two of the seven frat members were expelled, with the others got lesser punishments, including writing an essay, according to the filed complaint . For me, the horrific details of the case, coupled with the lack of accountability, have been the trigger for decades-old feelings to emerge. Fifty-two years ago, as a young girl, I was dismissed from Syracuse University. The men who had drugged me, plied me with alcohol and gang-raped me at a fraternity house went on with their lives, graduating with honors. I’m a nationally exhibited artist, but for decades, I could never say the words out loud that I failed out of art school my freshman year of college.
